question: Se qualcuno volesse fare oggi questo brick MEGLIO di noi, cosa aggiungerebbe?

competitors_known.name: Helicone
competitors_known.strength: Proxy SaaS che intercetta call LLM, dashboard, alerts. 1-line drop-in via Bearer header
competitors_known.weakness: SaaS terzo (privacy concerns), latenza extra +20ms, lock-in dashboard proprietaria, GDPR processor extra

competitors_known.name: Langfuse
competitors_known.strength: Open source self-host, tracing dettagliato, LLM eval, prompt management
competitors_known.weakness: Tooling Python-first (TypeScript SDK secondario), pesa infra (Postgres+Clickhouse+Redis), overhead per piccola agency

competitors_known.name: PostHog LLM observability
competitors_known.strength: Integrato con product analytics, schema event-based
competitors_known.weakness: Generalista, non specifico LLM cost-accounting, no cost calc native

competitors_known.name: OpenLLMetry (Traceloop)
competitors_known.strength: OpenTelemetry-based, vendor-neutral, integra con qualsiasi APM
competitors_known.weakness: OTel pipeline complessa per use-case agency mini, no cost-billing focus

what_competitor_would_add: Prompt logging opzionale + redaction PII automatica
Sampling configurabile per ridurre volume DB (1/100 calls a basso traffico)
Multi-tier storage (hot Postgres recent + cold archive S3 90gg+)
Replay testing (cattura -> rigioca su nuovo modello per regression)
Budget enforcement runtime (block call se tenant supera quota)
Webhook su anomalie (cost spike, error rate, rate-limit upstream)
what_we_already_do_better: ZERO LEAK garantito: insert sync con response, no fire-and-forget
Deno-native + JSR-publishable (no npm deps, edge-function ready)
Stesso DB del project (no HTTP cross-project = no failure mode)
Cost calc nativo (no servizio esterno per fatturazione cliente)
Drop-in replacement: 1 sostituzione per ogni call esistente
Multi-mode (chat, embeddings, audio, image gen) in singolo brick
Pricing table embedded versionata (no API lookup runtime)
Integra con cost-meter-per-model + llm-router-multi-provider (stack le-GO coerente)
roadmap_v0_4_0: Webhook alert su anomalie (Telegram CEO notify)
Sampling configurabile + auto-tune per traffico alto
speed_to_include: Q3 2026 streaming + budget enforcement; Q4 2026 alerting + sampling.
